title: MycoSci Species Record
description: Canonical fungal species record. See docs/SPECIES-DATA-MODEL.md.

identity.title: Identity & Record
identity.description: Stable internal keys, slug, record tier, primary common name, and the canonical accepted scientific name. The minimal anchor every taxon carries.

naming.title: Naming & Nomenclature
naming.description: Authorship, basionym, synonymy, homonymy, type specimen, nomenclatural acts, registration, and etymology. Owns the ICN naming layer.

classification.title: Classification & Phylogeny
classification.description: Ranked classification path (kingdom→infraspecific), parent linkage, species complex, molecular phylogenetic placement, sister taxa, and reclassification history.

morphology.title: Macroscopic Morphology
morphology.description: Naked-eye basidiome/ascoma features: cap, hymenophore, stipe, veils, flesh, latex, spore print, sensory, bruising, development. Genus-dependent and nullable.

microscopy.title: Microscopy & Anatomy
microscopy.description: Spores (dimensions, Q, ornamentation, reactions), basidia, cystidia, hyphal system, tissue layers, asci/ascospores, crystals, and measurement-protocol metadata.

chemistry.title: Chemistry, Toxins & Medicinal
chemistry.description: Toxin inventory and toxidromes, psychoactive and medicinal compounds, nutrition, bioaccumulation, allergens, pigments, and macrochemical spot tests. Owns compound identity and hazard axis.

edibility.title: Edibility & Safety
edibility.description: Safety-first edibility classification, preparation requirements, dangerous lookalikes, sensory/culinary profile, preservation, and consumption cautions. The actionable safety layer.

ecology.title: Ecology & Habitat
ecology.description: Trophic mode, substrate/host associations, habitat/biome, climate/soil preference, fruiting phenology, ecological role, and conservation status.

distribution.title: Distribution & Biogeography
distribution.description: Native/introduced range, country/region distribution, biogeographic realms, elevation, occurrence-record statistics, and range dynamics.

cultivation.title: Cultivation & Lab
cultivation.description: Cultivability, substrate recipes, environmental parameter ranges by phase, lifecycle timelines, yield, contamination, senescence, strains, and commercial positioning.

genetics.title: Genetics & Molecular
genetics.description: DNA barcodes/markers, genome assemblies, karyology, mating systems, ex-type sequences, intraspecific variation, and toxin/psilocybin biosynthesis gene clusters.

culture.title: Ethnomycology & History
culture.description: Multilingual vernacular names with provenance, discovery history, folklore, traditional/ritual use, cultural significance, and references in art and media.

media.title: Media
media.description: Images, microscopy, audio, video, and 3D assets — each independently licensed and credited, with view type, lifecycle stage, and ID verification status.

provenance.title: Provenance & Data Quality
provenance.description: Cross-cutting per-field source/confidence/verification model, citations, external authority links, record licensing, completeness/quality scoring, contributors, and dispute flags.
